Name: Strade portrait and Sprites
Author: BubblegumMurderer
Description:
A simple sprite replacement that changes Sam into Strade from Boyfriend to Death. Everything should be all in order, side hair is a little funky but all seems to be in order.

Strade and the art used for the first image belongs to Gatobob at http://gatobob.tumblr.com/.
